events.title: Mockingbird Jam 2026
events.description: Mockingbird Jam is our 2026 community fundraiser for ALS research and families dealing with ALS. Join us for yoga at 9 AM, church service at 10 AM, live music from 11 AM to 8 PM, food trucks, a silent auction, and all-day fundraising throughout the property.
events.image_alt: Mockingbird Jam to Defeat ALS fundraiser graphic announcing Sunday, September 13 at The Mockingbird on Mill Road

events.title: MuMu & Mimosas Brunch
events.description:
Grab your girls, throw on your boldest MuMu, and join us at The Mockingbird for the ultimate Sunday Funday! MuMu & Mimosas is a laid-back, high-energy brunch experience filled with bubbles, bites, and good vibes.

Your ticket includes 2 refreshing mimosas, a full brunch buffet, plus access to games, photo ops, and more. Show up in your BEST MuMu for a chance to win prizes and bragging rights!

Tickets are all-inclusive — no surprises at checkout.
events.payment_note: Includes 2 mimosas, brunch buffet, tax & gratuity

events.title: Father’s Day Backyard BBQ & Ohio Beer Flight
events.description: Celebrate Father’s Day at The Mockingbird with a laid-back afternoon of cold Ohio beer, backyard BBQ specials, cornhole, and good company. Join us from 3–7 PM for a relaxed backyard-style cookout featuring all-Ohio beer flights, BBQ-inspired food specials, patio games, and summer vibes throughout our outdoor space. No tickets required — all are welcome.

events.title: Paint & Sip: Twilight on the Farm
events.description: Join Wine & Canvas at The Mockingbird on Mill Road for Twilight on the Farm, a relaxing Paint & Sip Party featuring a peaceful countryside sunset with a silhouetted tree, barn, silo, and windmill. Guests will paint a 16×20 canvas with step-by-step guidance. Food and drinks will be available for purchase from The Mockingbird.
events.payment_note: Includes step-by-step instruction and all painting supplies. Food and drinks sold separately.

events.title: Mockingbird Book Club — July
events.description: Join us for Mockingbird Book Club on Thursday, July 16th at 6:30 PM as we discuss Falling by T.J. Newman — a gripping thriller about a commercial airline pilot forced into an impossible choice when his family is kidnapped and he's ordered to crash the plane he's flying. Written by a former flight attendant, this suspense-filled novel is packed with authentic aviation detail, high-stakes tension, and plenty to discuss. Enjoy an open, welcoming conversation with food and drinks available.
